title: Owner decision needed: if dynamic retrieval beats the fixed default by 3+ points, does the default stay fixed?
description:
## Owner decision needed (Q3)

Do not assume an answer. The plan only **reports** the comparison.

If dynamic retrieval plus features (A+D) beats the fixed default (A-c+F) by **≥3 points** on paper-600, does the default stay fixed, or does retrieval become the default (for example for small pools)?

## Definition of done

Answer recorded here once the results page exists (the owner may also answer earlier). Cost: $0.
